description: The chart illustrates ratio percentages for three LLMs across three content categories, showing how the measured “Ratio (%)” varies by model within each category. The category axis is horizontal with labeled groups “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball” (left to right), and within each group there are three adjacent bars corresponding to the models; the value axis is vertical and labeled “Ratio (%)” on a linear scale with visible tick labels at approximately 60, 70, 80, and 90 (and gridlines extending upward beyond 90). A legend at the top maps colors to models: Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow. In the “Movies” group, the blue Llama3 bar reaches a little above 90 (about 92), the red Qwen2 bar is slightly higher (about 94), and the yellow ChatGPT bar is around 79–80. In the “Songs” group, the blue Llama3 bar is in the mid-90s (about 94), the red Qwen2 bar is the tallest in the figure at roughly the high-90s (about 98), and the yellow ChatGPT bar is around 77–78. In the “Basketball” group, the blue Llama3 bar is around the mid-80s (about 85–86), the red Qwen2 bar is around the high-70s (about 78–79), and the yellow ChatGPT bar is around the low-to-mid 80s (about 83–84). The bars are grouped by category rather than sorted by height, and there are no special visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the color coding and legend.
